chapter: Meeting Jay McShann and Martin's on the Plaza
title: Becoming close friends with McShann, who drank
summary: Ramey kept the job and they became close friends while McShann was drinking heavily.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: Well, he's -- I don't want to put this on here. I gather when his wife died he was in New York, at Michael Virgii's Pub. And you were sort of -- you found him sort of a congenial companion, I take it.

Well, became very close friends. In fact, Hadnott was available to John right then, but he didn't want to join John until Gus came. And so I went in for the two weeks. But evidently -- anyway, the two weeks was up and Hadnott they had
not called him (inaudible) he said, I like what I got. So he let Pete go, but he kept me. And then we became like bosom friends, you know.
He still -- that's when he was really drinking, you know.
